name: Infanticide
overview: Scripture addresses the tragic reality of infanticide in various contexts, including Pharaoh's command to kill Hebrew male infants (Exodus 1:15-16) and God's judgment on Egypt through the death of firstborns (Exodus 12:29; Psalms 135:8). While the Mosaic law commands, "Thou shalt not kill" (Exodus 20:13), specific divine instructions in wartime situations, such as in Numbers 31:17, show God's sovereign judgment involving the destruction of certain groups. These passages reveal both the severity of sin and the holiness of God’s justice, underscoring the sanctity of life and the grave consequences of violating it.
